summary.en: Decide how much help a task needs, send it to the right agent, and keep it moving until it is done.
summary.zh: 先判断一件事要不要帮手，再派给合适的 agent，一直跟到做完。

title.en: Get a second pair of eyes

summary.en: Independent reviewers and review loops that stop only when the change is actually clean.
summary.zh: 请独立的 Reviewer 审改动，修完再审，直到真的没问题。

title.zh: 提交干净的 Git 历史

summary.en: Commits, branches and worktrees that stay tidy without you thinking about them.
summary.zh: 提交、分支和 worktree 自己保持整洁，不用你多操心。

summary.en: Connect Chrome, Figma and friends so your agent sees what you see.
summary.zh: 接上 Chrome、Figma 这些工具，让 agent 看到你看到的东西。

summary.en: Small helpers for the browser side: jump to source, keep i18n in shape, measure speed, serve local pages.
summary.zh: 浏览器这一侧的小帮手：点元素跳源码、维护多语言、测性能、搭本地网页。

summary.en: Design docs and weekly reports, plus audits that keep your files and agent setup in order.
summary.zh: 写设计文档和周报，顺手把文件和 agent 配置理清楚。

highlights.en: Splits work across the AI CLIs installed on your machine, each in its own worktree.
highlights.zh: 把活拆给本机装好的 AI CLI，各用各的 worktree。

highlights.en: Assigns an independent reviewer and cleans up the workers afterwards.
highlights.zh: 安排独立复审，做完把 worker 清理干净。

highlights.en: A headless reviewer reviews, fixes and re-reviews your Git diff until it passes.
highlights.zh: 无头 Reviewer 审、修、再审你的 Git diff，直到通过。

highlights.en: Checks pasted review comments against the code before anything is fixed.
highlights.zh: 先拿代码核对贴来的评审意见，再决定怎么修。

highlights.en: Runs local checks and a remote preflight before it pushes.
highlights.zh: 推送前先跑本地验证和远端预检。

highlights.en: Never force-pushes; stops on secrets or an unexpected push target.
highlights.zh: 从不强推，碰到密钥或意外的推送目标就停下。
